name: China National Chemical Engineering Co., Ltd
summary: China National Chemical Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the chemical engineering business in China. It is involved in the contracting of construction engineering, petrochemicals, coal chemical industry, fine chemicals, pharmaceuticals, electric power, environmental ecological protection, infrastructure engineering and overseas engineering; and engineering consulting, surveying, design, construction, and project management and services.
